question: The Harappan site at which bones of camel were discovered?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kalibangan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **__Important Points__**

__
 
• Remains of Camel were discovered in Kalibangan archaeological site.
 
• Camel bones found in Kalibangan belonged to 2000 B.C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• Surkotada was excavated by Shri Jagat Pati Joshi in 1964 - 1968.
 
• The presence of Horse Bone was found in Surkotada.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e085a7f17645c801966c030eb44d69fae944b96fdb4c4077f5fba1bc2c24bc71.png] **Mistake Points__**

 
• **Kali Bangan:** It was identified as the world's earliest ploughed field.
 
• **Dholavira:** Stone water reservoir and Terracotta tumblers are found in this region.
 
• **Chanhudaro:** Copper knives, Razors, Spears, and Copper fish hooks are found in this region. This region is nicknamed "The Sheffield of India" by Earnest Mackay.
